title: NeuronSifter: Intervention Planning in CNS Microenvironments
abstract: arXiv:2609.35445v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prioritizing central nervous system (CNS) interventions requires predicting how a dose, route, and schedule act on a partially observed microenvironment, then choosing the measurement that would change the decision. Action-conditioned predictors reduce a regimen to an identity token or a scalar exposure, discarding where and when the target is engaged; handing a point estimate to a separate planner then discards the joint uncertainty that makes a measurement worth running. We therefore treat decision quality as a property of the intervention interface, not of controller placement. NeuronSifter compiles regimens into state-conditional target-occupancy fields with support masks, propagates them through microenvironment dynamics with an occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator, and selects measurements by their expected reduction in intervention loss, assimilating typed outcomes into the same posterior. translated_title: NeuronSifter：中枢神经系统微环境中的干预规划
translated_abstract: 对中枢神经系统（CNS）干预进行优先级排序，需要预测剂量、给药途径和给药方案如何作用于一个部分观测的微环境，进而选择能够真正改变决策的测量手段。现有的动作条件预测器将给药方案简化为身份标识符或标量暴露量，丢弃了靶点在何处、何时被作用的信息；而将点估计交给独立的规划器，又会丢弃使测量值得执行的联合不确定性。因此，我们将决策质量视为干预接口本身的属性，而非控制器部署方式的问题。NeuronSifter 将给药方案编译为带支持掩码的状态条件靶点占据场，通过占据条件扩散算子在微环境动力学中传播该场，并根据干预损失的期望下降幅度来选择测量手段，同时将类型化的结果同化到同一后验分布中。在一个公开声明的合成阿尔茨海默（模型）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: NeuronSifter 的核心创新在于将决策质量构建于干预接口本身：它把给药方案编译为状态条件下的靶点占据场，用占据条件扩散算子在微环境动力学中传播，并依据干预损失的期望下降来选择测量手段，同时将不同类型的观测结果同化到同一后验分布中。
en_tdlr: NeuronSifter's key contribution is embedding decision quality into the intervention interface itself: it compiles dosing regimens into state-conditional target-occupancy fields, propagates them through microenvironment dynamics with an occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator, and selects measurements by their expected reduction in intervention loss while assimilating typed outcomes into a shared posterior.
